entities.summary: Colonel Aladár Antero Zoltán Béla Gyula Árpád Paasonen, known as Aladár Paasonen, was a Finnish military officer who served as Chief of Intelligence of the Finnish Defence Forces during the Continuation War, and later in the CIA.
